sources.evidence: LOU-100 bench (Grok's Bot 2): gpt-5.4-mini 0/3 with corrupt patches; gpt-6.2-sol passed but took shortcuts. gpt-6.2-sol billed payer=developer 2026-11-18 15:39 PST and 2026-11-19 07:00 and 10:19 PST.

fleet.note: No shared filesystem across machines, so each machine may use only its share of each group's fleet ceiling. The shares sum to 1.0, so the fleet cannot jointly cross a ceiling.

official_1M.note: Launch/Grow 1M token group, shared across every model in it. A request that would cross the cap is billed in full.

official_10M.note: Launch/Grow 10M token group, shared across every model in it. A request that would cross the cap is billed in full.

empirical_6.2.note: Not on the help article's lists. payer=openai was seen empirically but gpt-6.2-sol was also billed payer=developer three times. Sol is off by default; Astra is for small --hard jobs only. Billing on these models depends on request size (Grok's Bot 1, receipts Nov 17-19): all 13 payer=openai calls were <=2,989 total and <=978 output; the three billed Sol calls were 9,998, 18,738 and 3,145 total. --hard does not bypass the size caps.

default_request_caps.note: Applied to any model without its own caps. Raise a cap only with payer=openai evidence at that size.

hard_blocks.reason: -pro and gpt-5.3-codex were billed (gpt-5.5-pro probe returned payer=developer); gpt-4.5-preview is shut down.

route_notes.small_patch: Docs: 6.1 Sol is near-Astra for complex coding at lower cost; 6 Sol is built for coding; 5.4 is the affordable coding flagship. 5.6 Terra keeps patches off the 1M group when it is near its cap. gpt-5.4-mini is excluded (LOU-100 0/3). Code kinds only use models with code_trusted=true (set after a passing probe).
route_notes.large_change: 6 Astra is the listed reasoning model for complex coding; 6.2 Astra is last because it is unlisted and limited to small --hard jobs.
route_notes.review: Reading-heavy and quality-sensitive: strongest listed models first, 5.6 Terra as the 10M fallback.
route_notes.docs_text: Writing is cheap to verify, so the 10M group goes first (5.6 Terra balances quality and cost).
route_notes.extraction: Nano/mini-tier models are documented for focused high-volume work; keep the 1M group for last.
route_notes.long_context: 10M-group models with 1.05M-token context go first so long inputs do not exhaust the 1M group.
